name: Moss-backed Tanager
rangeDescription: Andean foothills of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Peculiar tanager found in Andean cloud forest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Plumage is olive with a yellow spot on breast, blue wings, and a distinctive blue and black pattern on the head.

name: Yellow-winged Cacique
rangeDescription: Pacific lowlands of western mexico (southeastern sonora) to southeastern guatemala
description: Spectacular and conspicuous black-and-yellow bird of tropical lowlands in west Mexico. Favors deciduous forest and edges, plantations, and hedges with tall trees; often in towns and villages, especially near streams and rivers.

name: Abyssinian Ground-Hornbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to ethiopia, northern uganda, and northeastern kenya
description: A huge ground-dwelling hornbill. Males have a mix of blue and red bare facial skin, while females have entirely blue facial skin.

name: Gray Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Southeastern china from south-central sichuan, far eastern yunnan, guizhou, guangxi, and northern guangdong) and n vietnam
description: While this is a predominantly gray laughingthrush, the black mask, brownish throat, and white patch behind the ear are all more eye-catching. Overall coloration is similar to that of Black-throated Laughingthrush but note pale eyebrow connected to small white ear patch, and that the black mask does not extend down to the upper breast.

name: Palau Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Palau (western caroline islands)
description: Small cuckooshrike with a restricted range, found only on the Palau Archipelago. Males are mainly gray with a black patch on the face, black tail, and black on the wings.

name: Golden Palm Weaver
rangeDescription: Savanna of ethiopia to southern somalia, eastern kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: Breeding male is bright yellow with a mostly orange head. The female is duller, though still very yellow.

name: Gray-headed Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (morotai, halmahera, bacan, tidore, and ternate)
description: A small, strikingly handsome green dove with contrastingly pale gray head and markings on the back and wings, a deep claret-colored belly patch, and a lemon-yellow underside to the tail. Unique within its limited range in the north Moluccas.

name: Rufous-collared Robin
rangeDescription: Highlands of s mexico (chiapas) to central honduras
description: Large, bulky thrush of highlands south of Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Found in pine-oak forest, adjacent farmland, and villages.

name: Yellowhead
rangeDescription: Forest of south and stewart islands (new zealand)
description: A small forest-dwelling songbird endemic to the South Island of New Zealand. Distinctive yellow head and yellowish to white underparts.

name: Pale-billed Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of northern peru (amazonas and la libertad)
description: Distinctive antpitta found only in high-elevation cloud forest on the east slope of the Andes in northern Peru. Adult has chestnut upperparts, gray underparts, a black face and throat, a chalky white bill, and a red eye.

name: Sula Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu, seho, mangole, and sanana)
description: A small brown owl with indistinct ear tufts (often not visible) and yellow irises. Largely brown, mottled with dark streaks and markings over much of the body, with pale and white markings on the wings.

name: Gouldian Finch
rangeDescription: Northern australia (kimberley division to western cape york peninsula)
description: A brilliantly colorful, unmistakable bird with vivid green back, yellow belly, purple chest, blue nape, black throat, and very pale bill; face may be red, yellow or black. Juvenile dull olive above, pale below, with paler bill than most other small finch-like birds.

name: Grenada Wren
rangeDescription: Grenada (lesser antilles)
description: Small brownish wren found only on Grenada. Plumage cinnamon-brown overall, with dark barring on the wings and tail.

name: Long-tailed Duck
rangeDescription: Coasts of holarctic region
description: Diving duck that favors saltwater in winter and Arctic tundra pools in summer. Males are distinctive with black, white, gray, and brown patterns and long pointed tail.

name: Melodious Warbler
rangeDescription: Southwestern palearctic; winters in savanna of western africa
description: Medium-sized warbler, light olive-brown above and yellowish below with a rather long bill. Compared to Icterine Warbler, wings are shorter and lack the pale panel.

name: Damara Red-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Central namibia (southern damaraland)
description: Fairly small, slim, long-tailed hornbill. Note the red bill, dark eye, pale face, and heavily spotted back.

name: Slaty-backed Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (yamdena and larat)
description: An unmistakable black, white, and gray thrush. Gray upperparts and black head marked with bold white cheek patch and long white eyebrow.

name: Sao Francisco Sparrow
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (interior of minas gerais and bahia)
description: Handsome, poorly-known sparrow with a bright olive back and a black-and-white face pattern. Note the yellow bill with a black upper ridge.

name: Black-chested Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Wetar (lesser sundas)
description: An unmistakable, strikingly patterned songbird with a downcurved bill. Olive above, with a conspicuous white throat bordered below by a necklace of dark streaks.

name: Gray-backed Hawk
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western ecuador and adjacent northwestern peru
description: An endangered raptor found only in western Ecuador and immediately adjacent parts of Peru. It has white underparts, dark gray back and wings, and gray streaks on the head.
